$comment: Accepted npm audit advisories (m1-009). Checked by scripts/audit-check.mjs in CI. One entry per advisory (GHSA ID). For high and critical advisories, `affects` lists every package npm flagged through that advisory when it was accepted; a new package means a new dependency path and fails CI. reviewBy is at most maxReviewDays after accepted; an expired entry fails CI until it is re-decided. Re-decided under D-M0-5 (S5/S6) in m1-011 (2026-10-20): all three re-accepted unchanged, see `reviewed`. Never use `npm audit fix --force`: it would downgrade apostrophe to 3.x and nodemon to 1.x. m1-017 (2026-10-31): removed GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm (braces) and GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c (sprintf-js) because GitHub withdrew both advisories (2026-10-23 and 2026-10-22); installed versions unchanged.
auditSummary: 43 package findings (38 moderate, 5 high, 0 critical) from 3 advisories (1 high, 2 moderate). Production-only (--omit=dev): 42 findings, 4 high.

advisories.title: Tiptap: mergeAttributes() turns an own __proto__ key into inherited executable DOM attributes
advisories.scope: prod (apostrophe rich-text editor, admin UI only)
advisories.reason: apostrophe 4.34.0 depends on Tiptap 2.x (@tiptap/starter-kit ^2.27.2) for the rich-text editor, which only logged-in editors load. The advisory is fixed in Tiptap 3.30.4, outside apostrophe's supported range.
advisories.remediation: m1-011: apostrophe 4.34.0 still ships Tiptap 2.27.3; fixed only in Tiptap 3.30.4+, outside core's range. Exposure is limited to logged-in editors (rich-text editor). Upgrade when an apostrophe release moves to Tiptap 3; editor access reviewed under D-M0-11.

reviewed.result: npm audit unchanged: 43 findings (38 moderate, 5 high, 0 critical) from the same 3 advisories; production-only 42 (4 high). apostrophe 4.34.0, @apostrophecms/form 1.5.6 and db-connect 1.1.0 are the latest releases. No apostrophe advisory affects 4.34.0. No compatible fix exists for any of the three (GitHub advisory API: braces and sprintf-js have no patched version; Tiptap is fixed only in 3.30.4+).
